verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit exposes dispute-management functions (list_disputes, get_dispute, accept_dispute_claim) and refund tools (create_refund/get_refund), plus the broader REST API documents disputes coverage and webhooks for status notifications, giving developers a programmatic path to view and resolve disputes on agent transactions. However, evidence only shows accept_dispute_claim (siding with buyer) — there's no documented evidence-submission API (e.g., uploading proof/documents to contest a dispute) or explicit outcome-tracking beyond get_dispute's summary. Missing for 10: dedicated evidence-submission endpoint/tool, richer outcome/resolution detail beyond accept, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the dispute flow working end-to-end.
